text:
incident-bot: PAGED -> severity: P1 GPU capacity exhausted in prod (model-serving)
incident-bot: symptom: sustained pending pods, queue backlog rising, autoscaler failing to provision GPU nodes

sara: Noticing backlog; queue depth for batch-infer up ~10x. Some realtime endpoints returning 503s.

mike: kubectl get pods -n model-serving | grep Pending shows 9 Pending; 0/0 nodes available: 5 node(s) didn't have GPUs, 4 node(s) match constraints but not ready.

leo: Cluster-autoscaler logs: repeated errors when creating ASG -> API 403: "iam:PassRole denied" and CreateAutoScalingGroup failing. Also a subsequent message about LaunchTemplateId mismatch.

carla: Can we see the autoscaler error dump?

leo: paste: ```
E0318 08:12:10 scale_up.go:245] Failed to create ASG: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
status code: 403, request id: 5f3a1c5b
caused by: iam:PassRole denied for arn:aws:iam::111111:role/redwood-autoscaler-role
---
WARN: LaunchTemplateId mismatch: expected lt-0a1b2c3d (v4) but template used lt-0d4c3b2a (v5)
```

oncall: I'm on it. Quick impact check: which customer-facing services are affected? Any SLA tenants?

sara: tenant-gamma realtime inference endpoints showing ~28% 503s over last 7m. tenant-delta (batch) backlog growing, retries piling up.

mike: Queue-proxy logs: enqueue 900rps, worker consumption limited by GPU token availability. Several jobs timing out after queue_producer max_retries.

infra-eng: Recent infra change: launch-template rotation last night replaced instance profile and AMI. Autoscaler config still references old instance profile name `redwood-gpu-profile-v2` and LT id v4. That causes PassRole because ASG creation attempts to assume old instance profile ARN which no longer exists / not allowed.

carla: Who merged the LT rotation? @deploy-bot do you have rollout info?

deploy-bot: rollout/launch-template-rotate completed by @jess at 2026-03-18T01:23:47Z; new LT id: lt-0d4c3b2a (v5); instance profile: redwood-gpu-profile-v3

leo: So autoscaler tries to create ASG with old role/instance-profile -> AWS blocks PassRole and creation fails.

oncall: Mitigation options: 1) quick patch autoscaler config to v5, 2) manual bootstrap of GPU nodes into cluster, 3) temporary granting of PassRole to autoscaler principal by security. Which is fastest?

infra-eng: Patch is fastest if we can safely roll. I'll prepare a configmap edit for cluster-autoscaler and coordinate a rolling restart. Might take ~10-15m. Manual bootstrap can be done in parallel by SRE.

mike: We should also limit low-priority batch jobs to CPU fallback to preserve GPUs for realtime. Patch the job-queue routing config.

carla: Right now tenant-gamma is most critical. Sara please toggle priority routing.

sara: Done. Redirected batch to CPU for low-priority tenants. GPU backlog still big but growth rate slowed.

leo: Opening security ticket to allow PassRole for autoscaler service account for 30m while we rotate config: ticket SEC-10233.

security-bot: Ticket SEC-10233 created. Auto-acknowledge: Security oncall pinged.

infra-eng: Applying autoscaler config patch now -> changing instanceProfile and launchTemplate id to v5. Pushing as configmap `cluster-autoscaler-config` in kube-system.

deploy-bot: configmap cluster-autoscaler-config updated by infra-eng at 2026-03-18T08:28:55Z

mike: Autoscaler triggered scale-up. ASG create started. New instances are in Pending:Provisioning. Watching node join.

infra-eng: New nodes came up with AMI v5; kubelet labels are applied but there's a taint mismatch: upstream node-provisioner expects taint key `gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule` but AMI now applies `redwood/gpu-reserved=true:NoSchedule`. Pods with tolerations not matching won't schedule.

carla: Ugh. More drift. Can we add tolerations to the gpu-nodeSelector podSpec as a short-term patch? That risks touching many deployments.

mike: Short path: add the expected toleration to node-init daemon to ensure new nodes get the old taint key. Alternatively, run a script to retag/taint nodes after join.

infra-eng: I'll run `kubectl taint nodes` on the new nodes to apply `gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule` until we reconcile. Script underway.

leo: Also note: kubelet-register sometimes flips `kubernetes.io/arch` label on these AMIs, causing k8s scheduler mismatch for some pods. Keep an eye on that.

oncall: After taints were applied, pods started scheduling. Queue drain improved. tenant-gamma 503 rate down to ~6% in 10m.

sara: Monitoring: total impacted requests ~9.5k over 12 minutes. We'll prepare customer comms.

security-bot: Security oncall granted temporary iam:PassRole to autoscaler principal (arn:aws:iam::111111:role/redwood-autoscaler-role) for 45 minutes. Escalation note: SEC-10233.

infra-eng: With PassRole in place autoscaler completed ASG creation cleanly and we removed manual bootstrapped nodes. Starting a reconciliation run to ensure launch template IDs and instance profiles are sourced from a single canonical location.

carla: Action items being recorded:
- Canonicalize LT/instance-profile source in infra repo + autoscaler config (owner: infra-eng)
- Add integration test to detect LT/instance-profile drift during CI (owner: devex)
- Alert rule for repeated iam:PassRole 403s from autoscaler (owner: eng-sre)
- Runbook for emergency manual GPU bootstrap (owner: leo)
- Validate taint/toleration contract across AMI rotations (owner: eng-runtime)

mike: Customer update drafted for tenant-gamma ops: "We experienced transient GPU capacity shortage due to an autoscaler & launch-template mismatch after a launch-template rotation; mitigated by config patch and temporary role grant. Many requests were throttled; service largely restored. Detailed postmortem to follow."

oncall: Incident status -> mitigated, monitoring for 2h; will mark RESOLVED if stable.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED by oncall at 2026-03-18T08:54:05Z; RESOLVE window started.

mike: Final: please include SLA impact metrics in postmortem (requests failed, latency deltas). I'll export queue metrics and attach.

carla: Thanks everyone. I'll convert this thread into a postmortem doc and file owners on the action items.

deploy-bot: deployment autoscaler restarted by infra-eng at 2026-03-18T08:39:13Z
